headlines.title: Jim Cramer Says Netflix Worth the Risk as Wolfe Raises Price Target to $95
headlines.summary: Jim Cramer called Netflix a falling knife worth catching, but the chart tells a different story about when that window actually opened and whether retail viewers are hearing advice that already expired.

headlines.title: Netflix Stock Could Swing A Third Lower Or Half Higher In The Year Ahead
headlines.summary: The band its options price for the year ahead is wide on both sides, and the optimistic end does not quite reach the stock's high of the past twelve months.

headlines.title: 3-Year Streaming Outlook: Slowing Down Pricing Hikes
headlines.summary: Higher-priced ad-free options have seen greater price increases over the last three years vs. those for ad-supported tiers - at $1.62 per month vs. $1.21 per month.

headlines.title: NFLX Stock Eyes Sixth Week Of Gains: Netflix Reportedly Mulls Adding Rival Streamers To Compete With YouTube, Roku
headlines.summary: The New York Times reported earlier Tuesday that the streaming service is considering adding more streamers, like Comcast’s Peacock and Fox One, to its roster.

headlines.title: Is Netflix Getting Its Groove Back?
headlines.summary: One analyst says investors disenchanted with Netflix have lost the plot (in much the same way as the final season of Stranger Things).

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
